parallelize_model: parallelize a PyTorch model using FSDP sharding, tensor parallelism, activation checkpointing, and torch.compile
get_device_mesh: get a CUDA device mesh for data parallel replication, sharding, and tensor parallelism from DistributedArgs
setup_torch_distributed: setup torch distributed process group for multi-GPU, multi-node, or SLURM jobs with NCCL backend
check_model_value_range: check a PyTorch model for NaN, Inf, suspicious value ranges, large standard deviations, or all-zero parameters
dist_mean: compute the mean of a scalar value across all processes in a distributed device mesh using all_reduce
